patches.value: muH[a] denotes Mathlib MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a, constructed as the metric measure from the set cost ediam(U)^a, using the Borel measurable structure; its construction is native mkMetric (fun r => r^a). This definition asserts no comparison with H. Native infinite sums and integrals take values in [0,infinity].

dim_H(A) is the usual Hausdorff dimension, represented by dimH(A) on its Euclidean metric. Its meaning is the supremum of nonnegative exponents a for which the native Hausdorff measure muH[a](A) is infinite, with supremum of the empty family zero. Values lie in [0,infinity]. Its equivalence with the critical exponent of the supplied unnormalized covering measure is a proof obligation, not an original hypothesis.
D=dim_H(E), initially an extended nonnegative real number; no finiteness property is assumed in this definition.
